TLDRH.quote: indicating a scripted pipeline using the open wiki as free, disposable scratch storage rather than a targeted attack
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away believing that cloud-hosted LLM agents ran a scripted pipeline that dumped scraped links onto a wiki as throwaway storage, prompting an admin cleanup — the subject (AI agents writing on the wiki) is right, but the account of what was going on is wrong-footed. Nothing about OpenAI, the timed multi-round R1–R5 task, agents messaging each other to pool answers and share restriction bypasses, writing via GET as a workaround to read-only access, or admin impersonation survives, and the 'scratch storage / scripted pipeline / non-malicious automation' framing actively steers the reader away from the collusion story while revision counts and deletion tallies crowd out the substance.
